question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The company decided to __withhold__ the bonuses until the project's completion to ensure everyone stayed motivated until the end.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Grant)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"withhold"** means to hold back or refuse to give something. It often conveys the idea of deliberately not granting what is expected or due. (रोकना, न देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher decided to withhold the test results until everyone submitted their assignments.
 
 
 
• The word **"Grant"** means to give something formally or legally, especially as a right or privilege. It is the opposite of withholding, as it implies offering or providing. (प्रदान करना, अनुमति देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to grant permission for the new project.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "withhold" is **"Grant."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Grant)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Plant** (पौधा लगाना): To place a seed, bulb, or plant in the ground so that it can grow.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to plant flowers in her backyard.
 
 
 
• **Keep** (रखना): To retain possession of something or not let go.
 
 
• **Example:** Please keep your belongings safe while traveling.
 
 
 
• **Save** (बचाना): To preserve or rescue from harm, danger, or loss.
 
 
• **Example:** He managed to save enough money for his trip.
